limits.value: billed by the second; the metered CPU-only rate is $0.0117 per vCPU-hour plus $0.0055 per GiB-hour and a dedicated instance reserved for a month is $4.82/hr × 730 h
a persistent kernel bills at 1.08 times its running rate while stopped, so a stop is a surcharge rather than a saving
machines run from 1 to 32 vCPU and 1 to 128 GB of RAM, with a GPU attached per machine
